verdict.rationale: Devin Review with Auto-Fix explicitly auto-fixes CI failures and review comments, which could cover agent-readiness gate checks if they're wired into CI/PR review, and AGENTS.md support shows Devin can consume agent-readiness config files. However there's no evidence of a dedicated 'agent-readiness criteria' scorecard or targeted remediation workflow distinct from generic CI/review auto-fix. Missing for 10: explicit agent-readiness scoring/criteria detection, evidence of automatically remediating specific agent-readiness failures (vs generic CI/review comments), and independent validation of this auto-fix loop working reliably.
